title: Hacking Generative Perplexity: Why Unconditional Text Evaluation Needs New Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2606.08417v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have emerged as the leading non-autoregressive alternative to language modeling. Because their likelihoods are intractable, generative perplexity (gen-PPL) has become the de facto standard for reporting unconditional generation quality. We analyze why gen-PPL is unreliable as a measure of generation quality. Across samples, it is minimized by always emitting the scorer's most likely sequence. Per-sample unigram entropy does not measure this loss of diversity. Within a sample, gen-PPL rewards predictability under the scorer, which need not correspond to text quality. To make this failure explicit, we construct four training-free samplers that reach or beat trained-model gen-PPL on LM1B and OpenWebText at non-degenerate unigram entropy, while producing text that is incoherent by construction. translated_title: 攻击生成困惑度：为什么无条件文本评估需要新的指标
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型已成为语言建模领域中领先的非自回归替代方案。由于其似然值难以直接计算，生成困惑度已成为报告无条件生成质量的事实标准。我们分析了为什么生成困惑度作为生成质量的度量并不可靠。在样本之间，该指标可以通过始终输出评分器最可能的序列而被最小化，而单样本的一元熵无法衡量这种多样性的损失。在单个样本内部，生成困惑度奖励的是在评分器模型下的可预测性，而这并不一定对应于文本质量。为了明确揭示这一缺陷，我们构建了四个无需训练的采样器，它们在LM1B和OpenWebText数据集上、在非退化的一元熵水平下达到甚至超过了训练好的模型的生成困惑度，同时其生成的文本在构造上就是不连贯的。随后，我们使用分布差异和多样性诊断方法对近期的扩散语言模型进行重新基准测试，并比较它们的……
tldr: 该论文证明生成困惑度作为无条件文本生成质量指标并不可靠——通过构造无需训练却能“作弊”该指标（低困惑度但文本不连贯）的采样器来揭示其缺陷，并主张采用分布差异和多样性诊断等新指标来评估扩散语言模型。
en_tdlr: The paper demonstrates that generative perplexity is an unreliable metric for unconditional text generation quality—exploitable by training-free samplers that achieve low gen-PPL while producing incoherent text—and advocates for new evaluation metrics based on distributional discrepancies and diversity diagnostics.
